WinUI 3 graphics creation sites

Source locations requesting creation of compositors and related composition objects, visuals, surfaces, devices, drawing resources and CPU-side wrappers.

Jump to the source table · Download semicolon-delimited CSV

Creation expressions are not allocation counts. A helper call and its underlying factory can both appear. A CPU wrapper does not prove GPU allocation. Source paths and snippets are evidence; runtime reachability and frequency depend on feature/build gates, caching, recycling and device loss.

The main creation paths

PathWhat happensStarting code point

Compositor identity: WinUI initializes CompositionHelperHolder, obtains its main device and queries compositor interfaces. GetCompositor() and GetCompositorForCurrentThread() are acquisition, not new-compositor calls. The helper implementation is external to this tracked tree.

Recycling and backing storage: VisualContentRenderer::EnsureSpriteVisual only creates on its non-reuse path. DCompSurface::CreateWithNoHardware can create a wrapper without hardware backing. BeginDraw can acquire externally managed backing; it is not an explicit creation factory and is not counted here.
